Hi,

This sample is created for convenience in the examples (as you can find using google search on ggplot2's main page),

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/book/qplot.r

set.set(1410) # Make the sample reproducible
dsmall <- diamonds[sample(nrow(diamonds), 100), ]

Best wishes,

baptiste
